items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Charlie used to come by, when I was with Cab Calloway, he'd come by the theater and just sit back-stage and talk very seriously.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear Charlie say anything seriously like that, like Coleman, his views on life?
His views, yes, he was a very serious person like that, too. Charlie used to come by, when I was with Cab Calloway, he'd come by the theater and just sit back-stage and talk very seriously.
